settings.question: Where is Lush Beauty Mart located in Nagpur?
settings.answer: Our premier physical store is located Below Hotel Maitrayee, Near Lad Square, directly opposite Metro Station Pillar No. 213 & 214, North Ambazari Road, Gandhi Nagar, Nagpur – 440 010. We are open all 7 days from 10:30 AM to 9:30 PM with convenient customer parking.

settings.question: Are all the cosmetics and skincare products 100% genuine?
settings.answer: Yes, absolutely! We source 100% authentic, verified products directly from authorized brand distributors with genuine batch codes and manufacturer seals.

settings.question: How fast is local delivery in Nagpur?
settings.answer: We provide FREE Same-Day & Next-Day Doorstep Express Delivery across Nagpur for all orders above ₹499.

settings.question: Can I place orders directly on WhatsApp?
settings.answer: Yes! You can use our Instant 1-Click WhatsApp Order feature to order directly with our Nagpur showroom team on +91 91195 95951 via UPI or Cash on Delivery.
